method.admission: Existing half-window speech gate. No score or annotation determines the windows.
method.decisions: Strict exceedance of each previously fixed point. Report the strongest measured window, including below the point. Useful requires 0.30 IoU and half of the publisher-marked edit covered.
method.decode: Production mono signed 16-bit decode from 24 kHz to 16 kHz. Require a continuous zero-origin analysis clock. Map centisecond edit times exactly between the two sample rates.
method.dense: Native one-second windows every half second. Keep fully contained windows from four-second contexts at the start and end. Apply the previous dense affine frame reduction, keeping the lower of qualifying context medians.
method.groups: Compare each positive score against the real control in its same publisher triplet. Report raw flags and overlap separately for each role.
method.scope: All ten publisher preview triplets. Retain every annotated edit, including ones too short for either comparison window. One audiobook reader, one generator, two edit mechanisms and no artificial interference or fitting.
method.stock: Native two-second windows at source seconds 1 and 3. Omit a window when it cannot fit completely.
